description: Local lab measurements of the isolated MC-18 landing preview (SSR HTML bytes, DOM counts, asset sizes/transfer, CLS, interaction timing) plus the public production build size and production isolation probe for /marea.
knownLimitations: Lab data only: one local run, no field data, no CPU/network throttling, no mobile hardware.
The preview build is a development configuration (optimization disabled, source maps emitted); its JS/CSS sizes are not production budgets.
Transfer bytes are measured over loopback without compression; real CDN compression would reduce them.
Interaction timings include two animation-frame waits (~one frame floor) and are not a benchmark.
CLS is observed with PerformanceObserver during a single load; it is not a Core Web Vitals field metric.
Production bundle sizes are measured from the local build on this machine and are not a deployment guarantee.

notes: Single local run, loopback server, no CPU/network throttling.
Asset transfer bytes are HTTP response body bytes from the loopback preview server (no compression configured).
Interaction timings are measured in-page with two animation-frame waits; they include frame latency and are not a benchmark.
